title: Interstellar
description: A group of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity while Earth faces environmental collapse.

title: The Dark Knight
description: A masked vigilante faces a brilliant criminal mastermind who spreads chaos across Gotham City.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is given the dangerous task of planting an idea inside someone's mind.

title: Titanic
description: Two young people from different social classes fall in love aboard a luxury ship during its tragic maiden voyage.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family that is being terrorized by a dark supernatural presence inside their farmhouse.

title: Toy Story
description: A group of toys secretly comes to life and struggles with friendship and jealousy when a new action figure joins them.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a rebel warrior and a lone survivor escape a ruthless ruler in a high-speed desert chase.

title: The Hangover
description: A group of friends wakes up after a wild night in Las Vegas and must retrace their steps to find their missing friend.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness

title: Jurassic Park
description: Scientists create a theme park filled with cloned dinosaurs, but the creatures escape and threaten everyone on the island.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker discovers that reality is an artificial simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines controlling humanity.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator and fights his way toward revenge against the emperor who destroyed his family.

title: The Notebook
description: A young couple from different backgrounds falls deeply in love while facing family pressure, separation, and the passage of time.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family survives in silence in a world where deadly creatures hunt anything that makes a sound.

description: A teenager gains spider-like abilities and meets heroes from alternate dimensions while learning what it means to become a hero.

title: Knives Out
description: A detective investigates the mysterious death of a wealthy novelist while uncovering secrets and lies within his eccentric family.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science and engineering to survive while NASA works to bring him home.

title: John Wick
description: A retired assassin returns to the criminal underworld after a personal tragedy and hunts down the people responsible.

title: Coco
description: A young boy who dreams of becoming a musician enters the land of the dead and uncovers hidden truths about his family.

title: Shutter Island
description: A federal marshal investigates the disappearance of a patient from an isolated psychiatric hospital and begins questioning his own reality.

title: The Social Network
description: A college student creates a social networking platform that grows rapidly while friendships and business relationships fall apart.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to become competitive wrestlers and challenge traditional expectations in their community.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three engineering students navigate academic pressure, friendship, personal dreams, and the expectations placed on them by society.

title: Drishyam
description: A protective father uses intelligence and careful planning to protect his family after they become involved in a serious crime.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara

title: Tumbbad
description: A man obsessed with hidden treasure enters a dangerous world of ancient mythology, greed, and supernatural horror.

title: Andhadhun
description: A pianist pretending to be blind becomes trapped in a dangerous situation after witnessing events connected to a mysterious murder.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist is recruited to communicate with mysterious alien visitors and discovers that their language changes the way she understands time.

title: The Revenant
description: A frontiersman left for dead in the wilderness fights through brutal conditions to survive and seek revenge against those who betrayed him.

title: Ford v Ferrari
description: An automotive designer and a fearless race car driver work together to build a revolutionary car and compete against Ferrari in a famous endurance race.
